args.title: Bellwether warehouse automation articles — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/warehouse and its subscriber companion (https://insights.bellwether.example/warehouse/companion):

- Autonomous carts lifted warehouse pick rates by 18% in 2026.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks (companion piece).
